augmentation.description: Each question record contains root, split, and children objects: one unconditional target node, one binary conditioning split, and two conditional target children.

provenance.target_events_and_options: Derived from the supplied title and body, prioritizing the detailed body when they conflict.
provenance.conditioning_splits: Generated hypothetical scenarios motivated by each question; not extracted facts, observed outcomes, or externally verified predictions.
provenance.original_fields: Requested descriptive fields were removed. IDs, dates, contexts, questions, and split definitions are retained.

node_fields.root: The parent node containing id, resolution_date, context, target_event, question, and options. Child parent_id values refer to root.id.
node_fields.context: An empty string at the root. A child contains one complete conditioning clause without a terminal period and without the words given that.
node_fields.question: A concise probability question with an optional given that clause and a short estimation instruction.
node_fields.options: Two concise answer descriptions; children share the root options.
node_fields.split: The separate conditioning event B. Its context, question, and options estimate P(B) and P(not B); these options are distinct from the target event options.
node_fields.children: Exactly two target nodes, indexed by condition and complement, estimating P(A | B) and P(A | not B).

augmentation.prompt_template: Use each stored question directly. Questions omit probability-format instructions and appended resolution or condition definitions.

partition_semantics.target: yes = A; no = not A, where A is the target event.
partition_semantics.conditioning: condition = B; complement = not B. The complementary branch includes every failure of the affirmative definition, not merely the opposite extreme.
partition_semantics.report_based_conditions: When B explicitly requires a qualifying publication by a cutoff, the absence of such a publication satisfies not B. This does not assert that the underlying physical event did not occur.
partition_semantics.identity: P(A) = P(B) * P(A | B) + P(not B) * P(A | not B).
partition_semantics.zero_probability_condition: A conditional probability need not be elicited when its branch has probability zero; its contribution to the aggregate is zero.

temporal_policy.reason: The source provides a retrieval date but no original question creation date or required forecast information cutoff.
temporal_policy.generated_split_dates: Explicit dates in split definitions are design choices. October 14, 2026 is drawn from date_fetched as a reproducible split-window boundary only, not treated as the original question date.
temporal_policy.deadline_precedence: Preserve the deadlines in the target questions, including before versus by; resolution_date timestamps are retained unchanged.
temporal_policy.evaluation: Use one explicit information cutoff consistently for the root, split, and both children. Later information can make a branch certain or impossible.

augmentation.source_quality_policy: Question prompts are simplified. Original source resolution text is omitted; separate split definitions are retained.
